title: Garcia's Sweet Home
description:
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. Only 20 min to downtown, 4 miles to the zoo and 4 miles to Brentwood. It’s located in Nashville desirable Crieve Hall neighborhood. Close to coffee shop, groceries, park and restaurants.

The space
The main part of the house can be used in your enjoyment. A couple lives downstairs but they don’t have access to upstairs.

Guest access
You have access to the deck and the front of the house (not have access to go down the deck stairs)

Other things to note
The guests will not have access to downstairs , since a couple lives there.

There’s smart TV en the living room.
